# braintrust_users (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up many Braintrust users at once by email address or ID, or to list every user. Set exactly one of `emails`, `ids`, or `return_all`. Like `braintrust_user`, it fails if a requested email or ID doesn't match a user, unless `ignore_missing` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up several users at once. Fails if any email has no Braintrust account.
data "braintrust_users" "myteam" {
  emails = ["alice@example.com", "bob@example.com", "carol@example.com"]
}

resource "braintrust_group" "engineering" {
  name         = "Engineering"
  member_users = data.braintrust_users.myteam.users[*].id
}

# Skip emails without an account instead of failing; they are listed in
# `missing_emails`.
data "braintrust_users" "invited" {
  emails         = ["dave@example.com", "erin@example.com"]
  ignore_missing = true
}

output "not_signed_up_yet" {
  value = data.braintrust_users.invited.missing_emails
}

# List every user in the organization.
data "braintrust_users" "all" {
  return_all = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `emails` (Set of String) Look up users with these email addresses.
- `ids` (Set of String) Look up users with these IDs (UUIDs).
- `ignore_missing` (Boolean) If `true`, emails or IDs that don't match a user are listed in `missing_emails` or `missing_ids` instead of failing. Defaults to `false`.
- `return_all` (Boolean) Set to `true` to return every user in the organization.

### Read-Only

- `missing_emails` (Set of String) Requested emails that don't match a user. Only non-empty when `ignore_missing` is `true`.
- `missing_ids` (Set of String) Requested IDs that don't match a user. Only non-empty when `ignore_missing` is `true`.
- `users` (Attributes List) Matching users, sorted by email. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) URL of the user's avatar image.
- `created` (String) Date of user creation.
- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `family_name` (String) Family (last) name of the user.
- `given_name` (String) Given (first) name of the user.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (UUID).
